draft.title: Waybill: Procurement Automation for Hardware Teams
draft.purpose: Evaluate investment readiness by analyzing customer pain, value proposition, and evidence gaps.

sections.heading: Customer Problem
sections.content: Hardware engineers spend weeks on procurement: sourcing parts, chasing quotes, managing logistics, and tracking inventory. Current systems stop at PO approval, leaving physical delivery and inventory management unresolved.

sections.heading: Value Proposition
sections.content: Waybill automates end-to-end procurement: sourcing, negotiation, freight, customs, delivery, and inventory management. It scales with teams from R&D to production, using AI to manage inventory across volatile SKUs.

draft.decision_question: Does Waybill’s end-to-end procurement automation create defensible value for hardware teams, with scalable monetization and repeat demand?
draft.next_action: Request Waybill’s customer retention metrics and delivery cost records from their Y Combinator profile.
draft.completion_test: Confirm at least 3 active enterprise clients with measurable time savings and repeat usage, alongside unit economics showing positive margins.
